import unittest

from parcelkit.weights import block_count, to_grams


class TestWeights(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_to_grams_rounds(self):
        self.assertEqual(to_grams(1.2504), 1250)
        self.assertEqual(to_grams(0), 0)

    def test_block_count_counts_started_blocks(self):
        self.assertEqual(block_count(0), 0)
        self.assertEqual(block_count(1), 1)
        self.assertEqual(block_count(100), 1)
        self.assertEqual(block_count(101), 2)

decisions: - D1 | bo | parcels are weighed gross by the scanner; the manifest subtracts TARE_G = 419 g from each weight (never below 0 g) before calling rate_cents, which takes the net weight | 2026-11-20
commits.message:
rates: price every started 100 g block; decide how parcels are weighed (ticket 3)

DECISION D1 (bo, agreed with ada): the scanner reports GROSS weight. Before a parcel is priced the manifest subtracts a tare of TARE_G = 419 g from the scanner weight, never going below 0 g. rate_cents takes the NET weight and does not know the tare, so the caller must subtract it. Pitfall: pricing the gross weight overcharges every parcel.

import unittest

from parcelkit.ledger import total_cents


class TestLedger(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_sum_and_refusal_of_floats(self):
        self.assertEqual(total_cents([450, 485]), 935)
        self.assertEqual(total_cents([]), 0)
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            total_cents([1.5])
